description: This file implements multiple commands related to 'git reflog', including listing, showing, deleting, checking existence, writing, dropping, and expiring reflog entries. It defines usage documentation, command implementations, helper functions, and the main command dispatcher for reflog operations within the Git source code.

classes.name: worktree_reflogs
classes.description: Data structure holding a worktree reference and a list of reflogs associated with it.

methods.name: int collect_reflog(const char * ref,void * cb_data)
methods.description: Callback function to collect reflog references from a worktree, avoiding duplicates from shared refs.

methods.name: int expire_unreachable_callback(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Handles the '--expire-unreachable' option to set expiry times for unreachable reflog entries.

methods.name: int expire_total_callback(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Handles the '--expire' option to set expiry times for reflog entries based on total age.

methods.name: int cmd_reflog_show(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Implements the 'git reflog show' command to display reflog entries.

methods.name: int show_reflog(const char * refname,void * cb_data UNUSED)
methods.description: Helper function to print a reflog reference name.

methods.name: int cmd_reflog_list(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Implements the 'git reflog list' command to list all reflogs.

methods.name: int cmd_reflog_expire(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Implements the 'git reflog expire' command to prune old reflog entries based on expiry settings.

methods.name: int cmd_reflog_delete(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Implements the 'git reflog delete' command to delete specified reflogs.

methods.name: int cmd_reflog_exists(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Implements the 'git reflog exists' command to check if a reflog exists for a given reference.

methods.name: int cmd_reflog_drop(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo)
methods.description: Implements the 'git reflog drop' command to remove reflogs from references.

methods.name: int cmd_reflog_write(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo)
methods.description: Implements the 'git reflog write' command to manually write a reflog entry.

methods.name: int cmd_reflog(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repository)
methods.description: Main dispatcher for 'git reflog' subcommands, routing to specific implementations.
